notes: STATUS CHANGE (Aug 2026): Wyoming's first RHTP application window opened July 1, 2026 and CLOSED at midnight on Aug 2, 2026. As of Aug 6, 2026 the Submittable portal (wyrhtp.submittable.com/submit) shows 'There are presently no open calls for submissions.' Wyoming ran two parallel tracks: (1) RFAs for most sub-initiatives through Submittable, due Aug 2, 2026 - every applicant also had to complete the '0.1 Applicant Eligibility Information' form; (2) three technology-vendor RFPs through standard state procurement on Public Purchase, due July 31, 2026: 3.2 Statewide telespecialist platform (bidId 214178), 3.3 Non-emergency transportation coordination (bidId 214188), 3.4 Centralized billing capacity (bidId 214186). Per the WDH timeline, Aug 2026 - Sept 2026 is the awards and drawdown window, with an Oct 1, 2026 contract execution deadline and full obligation of BP1 funds by Oct 30, 2026. Approved costs must be expended by Sept 30, 2027. WDH anticipates issuing ONE-YEAR agreements with the option to renew or amend in subsequent years, and awardees will update work plans and budgets annually - so subsequent-year funding is expected to flow largely through renewals of the Aug 2026 cohort rather than a fresh open competition. Wyoming's approved application covers 12 projects nested in four initiatives: Access to Emergency Medical Care, Rural Workforce Supply, Health Technology Transformation, and Make Wyoming Healthy Again (primary care/FQHC expansion, chronic disease and healthy lifestyle work). CMS award number RHTCMS332082-01-02, $205,004,742.95 in Budget Period 1. HB 122 signed by Gov. Gordon March 6, 2026; CMS approved the Year 1 plan mid-May 2026; the perpetuity fund was NOT approved. WDH maintains a public document library linked from the program page. Media/policy contact: Monique McBride, Chief Policy & Communication Officer.
